events.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Manchester United 0, Ipswich Town 1. Leif Davis (Ipswich Town) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Abdul Fatawu.
Sasa Lukic (Ipswich Town) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Abdul Fatawu (Ipswich Town) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.

Goal! Manchester United 1, Ipswich Town 1. Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Matheus Cunha with a through ball following a fast break.
Substitution, Ipswich Town. Chuba Akpom replaces Emersonn.
Own Goal by Jacob Greaves, Ipswich Town. Manchester United 2, Ipswich Town 1.Goal confirmed following VAR Review.
Jacob Greaves (Ipswich Town) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Manchester United 3, Ipswich Town 1. Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Substitution, Ipswich Town. Exequiel Palacios replaces Marcelino Núñez.
Goal! Manchester United 4, Ipswich Town 1. Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner.
Substitution, Ipswich Town. Abdoul Ouattara replaces Sasa Lukic.
Substitution, Ipswich Town. Darnell Furlong replaces Daizen Maeda.
Substitution, Manchester United. Noussair Mazraoui replaces Luke Shaw.
Substitution, Manchester United. Leny Yoro replaces Diogo Dalot.
Substitution, Manchester United. Andrey Santos replaces Kobbie Mainoo.
Substitution, Manchester United. Patrick Dorgu replaces Marcus Rashford.
Substitution, Manchester United. Benjamin Sesko replaces Matheus Cunha.
Goal! Manchester United 5, Ipswich Town 1. Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) left footed shot from outside the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Bruno Fernandes following a fast break.
Substitution, Ipswich Town. Kasey McAteer replaces Abdul Fatawu.
Goal! Manchester United 5, Ipswich Town 2. Chuba Akpom (Ipswich Town) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Julio Enciso.
Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
